_doc: Autonomous merge policy for .claude/bin/merge_gate.py (CLAUDE.md §8). A session may squash-merge a PR only through that script, which requires: the PR targets `base`; verify-head --ci says VERIFIED for the head SHA; no AI-tool mentions in title/body; no changed file matches `founder_paths`, nor `founder_paths_trial` up to and including `trial_until`; and, last, a Codex CLI review that the script runs itself on the exact head SHA ends in `VERDICT: APPROVE`. Founder-path PRs stay founder-merged. Patterns are fnmatch globs on repository paths (`*` also matches `/`). founder_paths are permanent: they define the checks and guards that gate this very merge, so an agent must never be able to merge a change to them. founder_paths_trial cover the control paths the founder reviews during the autonomy trial; extend it by moving trial_until.
